summary.calibration_note: pentagon_jbook returned NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE for every J-Book-grounded claim because our corpus (PB2026 / FY24-26) post-dates the PIT cutoff of 2023-01-15. This is a CORPUS COVERAGE GAP, not a SEVERE_UNDERDELIVERY against KTOS — applying the J-Book Calibration Heuristic #7, NOT_FOUND ≠ red flag. usaspending corroborates the past-revenue claims for the Aerial Targets / SSAT business line ($1.12B+ to Kratos Unmanned Aerial Systems alone, 140 awards). The KTOS narrative is broadly diversified and does not stake the thesis on any single named PE — it is a 'long-established DoD prime' filing, not the YSS/IONQ single-PE concentration pattern. Result: no J-Book divergence signal detected at this PIT — consistent with KTOS's cohort role as comparison anchor rather than a flagged short.
